name: launch-audit
title: Launch Audit: security headers, leaked keys & source maps
description: Passive pre-launch audit of a live web app from its URL: HTTPS and HSTS, security headers, cookie flags, API keys leaked in JavaScript bundles, public source maps, exposed .env/.git, Supabase/Firebase notes, robots/sitemap, stack and page weight. Score 0-100 with a fix for every finding.
